summary: 1043 sequence records: 481 RefPlantNLR, Sr6, 394 MorexV3 and 167 Arabidopsis NB-ARC candidates. 3 exact-sequence phenotype records admitted for condition-specific display.
validationStatus: Descriptive dataset audit only. Predictive capability is not established. Conservative homology grouping places 1,035 records in one component; independent train/test evaluation is not currently viable.

proteomes.method: PF00931.29 gathering cutoffs; longest isoform per source gene
PF00931.29 gathering cutoffs; longest isoform per source gene

published_arabidopsis_nlrtracker.source: RefPlantNLR 2021 S3 Appendix; NCBI GCF_000001735.4; not the same annotation as Ensembl release 62

homology.method: All-pairs Smith-Waterman on standardized PF00931 domains, BLOSUM62, gap open -10 / extend -0.5; >=30% identity over alignment columns and >=70% aligned residues in BOTH domains; single-link connected components plus exact full-sequence identity.
homology.limitations: Homology thresholding does not prove evolutionary independence. Conservative transitive groups can be large. Domain-lacking records are quarantined. No model was trained; folds are a prospective assignment, not cross-validation performance.

metricsReason: The three admitted phenotype examples were already used for hypothesis design; they do not constitute an independent evaluation set. Mixed assays and sparse labels also preclude defensible predictive performance estimates.
